notes: The Symbolic Convex Analysis Toolkit (SCAT) originally written by Chris Hamilton and Jonathan Borwein is a Maple package for symbolic computation of various objects from convex anlysis including Fenchel conjugates and subdifferentials. We are actively working on further development of the package but the bulk of the source code is credited to Borwein & Hamilton.
